Kept the ethos content rather than deleting it, since Features already advertises real, usable "Multi-identity via ethos" / `switch_identity` functionality this section documents.

**CONTRIBUTING.md — too sparse to be useful.** Three code blocks and one paragraph, no headings, no prerequisites, no build/test walkthrough, no branch/commit convention, no PR-submission expectations. Fleshed out with verified content: Go version prerequisite, clone+build walkthrough, testing (including `make test-integration`, which the original didn't mention), the existing quality-gate content, the branch-prefix table and commit-message format from `docs/WORKFLOW.md`, and PR-submission expectations scoped to what an external OSS contributor needs — not the internal bead/mission ceremony, which doesn't apply to them (this repo is public, MIT-licensed).

Closes beadle-19s, beadle-m9l.

- [x] `make check` passes (docs-only)
- [x] `npx markdownlint-cli2` — 0 errors
